obs-studio.setup:
# Must rebuild libcef_dll_wrapper, using the prebuilt wrapper
# causes obs to segfault whenever a browser source is added
cmake \
    -G Ninja \
    -S %(buildroot)/cef \
    -B %(buildroot)/cef/wrapper-build \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DCMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY=%(buildroot)/cef/libcef_dll_wrapper
cmake --build %(buildroot)/cef/wrapper-build --target libcef_dll_wrapper

%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-load-distro-crlset.patch

# failing to load a core module stops all subsequent modules from
# loading in. keep obs-browser last since it may or may not exist
%patch %(pkgdir)/0002-load-obs-browser-last.patch

# from tytan's aur, allow distro branding to appear in logs and windows
%patch %(pkgdir)/0003-display-distro-branding.patch

# don't hardcode GNU objdump, TODO: remove when merged
# https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13763
%patch %(pkgdir)/0004-use-cmake-objdump.patch

%cmake \
    -DCEF_ROOT_DIR="%(buildroot)/cef" \
    -DENABLE_BROWSER=ON \
    -DENABLE_JACK=ON \
    -DENABLE_LIBFDK=ON \
    -DENABLE_SNDIO=ON \
    -DOBS_VERSION_OVERRIDE="%(version)"

opencv.setup:
# TODO build extra modules, python module, etc, VTK, GTK

# Using `BUILD_OPENCV_*` options we disable all extra modules from opencv_contrib that we don't explicitly need
# To make this easier on ourselves let's allowlist the modules we want and disable every other one
# Technically we don't need plot but tracking checks for it so it can build samples (which we don't end up installing anyway)
# 2026-09-18: optflow and ximgproc from request https://github.com/aerynOS/recipes/issues/2621
# 2026-11-06: [opencv 5.1] xobjdetect now provides cv::CascadeClassifier, which the GStreamer OpenCV plugin uses
modules=(bgsegm optflow plot tracking ximgproc xobjdetect)
contrib_cmake_args=""
pushd contrib/modules
directories=(*)
for dir in "${directories[@]}"
do
    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
        if [[ " ${modules[*]} " =~ " ${dir} " ]]; then
            contrib_cmake_args+="-DBUILD_opencv_${dir}=ON "
        else
            contrib_cmake_args+="-DBUILD_opencv_${dir}=OFF "
        fi
    fi
done
popd

# I think this is a openblas issue, none of this should be required
export FC=flang
export LDFLAGS+=" -lopenblas"

# Add x86-64v2 CPU flags to baseline (See `cmake/OpenCVCompilerOptimizations.cmake`)
%patch %(pkgdir)/freetype-harfbuzz-prefix.patch

%cmake \
    -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DBUILD_PERF_TESTS=OFF \
    -DBUILD_PROTOBUF=OFF \
    -DBUILD_TESTS=ON \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 \
    -DCPU_BASELINE_REQUIRE="SSE;SSE2;SSE3;SSSE3;SSE4_1;SSE4_2;POPCNT" \
    -DINSTALL_C_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DINSTALL_PYTHON_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DOPENCV_ENABLE_NONFREE=OFF \
    -DOPENCV_EXTRA_MODULES_PATH=contrib/modules \
    -DOPENCV_GENERATE_PKGCONFIG=ON \
    -DOPENCV_GENERATE_SETUPVARS=OFF \
    -DPROTOBUF_UPDATE_FILES=ON \
    -DWITH_FLATBUFFERS=OFF \
    -DWITH_IPP=OFF \
    -DWITH_JPEGXL=ON \
    -DWITH_LAPACK=ON \
    -DWITH_OPENMP=ON \
    -DWITH_QT=ON \
    -DWITH_VA=ON \
    -DWITH_VULKAN=ON \
    -DVULKAN_INCLUDE_DIRS=%(includedir)/vulkan \
    ${contrib_cmake_args} \
    -Wno-author
opencv.install:
%cmake_install

# Deprecated module packages, kept until moss can remove packages
for i in %(name)-calib3d %(name)-features2d %(name)-ml; do
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(docdir)/${i}
    echo "DEPRECATED" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/${i}/README
done
opencv.check:
# opencv_extra carries the test data; most tests need it now that findDataFile() defaults to required
# GTEST_FILTER drops upstream-failing tests:
#   hal_intrin128.int32x4*              signed overflow in the reference dotprod sum (UB, clang)
#   Imgcodecs_Png_Encode/ImwriteFlags   compares encoded size against pngsuite, differs with libpng 1.6.59
#   *GSTREAMER* / *gstreamer*           needs muxers/decoders that are not in the build root
# ctest skips the dnn suite (Vulkan/VKCOM backend fails upstream in 5.1.0) and highgui (needs a display)
export GTEST_FILTER="-hal_intrin128.int32x4*:Imgcodecs_Png_Encode.*:Imgcodecs_Png_ImwriteFlags.*:*GSTREAMER*:*gstreamer*"
export OPENCV_SAMPLES_DATA_PATH="$(cd %(builddir)/.. && pwd)/samples/data"
export OPENCV_TEST_DATA_PATH="$(cd %(builddir)/../../extra && pwd)/testdata"
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
%cmake_test -E "opencv_test_(dnn|highgui)"

subpackages.description:
Fundamental data types such as Mat, matrix and array operations, dynamic data
structures and the module infrastructure shared by all other OpenCV modules.

Headers, CMake config files, pkg-config file and vendor suppressions needed to
build software against OpenCV.
Algorithms for background and foreground segmentation in video sequences.

Camera calibration and 3D reconstruction routines such as calibrateCamera and
stereoCalibrate.

Deep learning inference for ONNX and TFLite models, including the classic engine
and the new default engine.

Feature detectors and descriptors such as SIFT, ORB, FAST and MSER, together with
descriptor matchers.

Fast approximate nearest neighbour search and clustering used by other OpenCV
modules.
Homography, solvePnP, affine estimation and computational geometry on point sets.
Window display, trackbars and the Qt based image and video user interface backend.

Reading and writing images in PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, JPEG XL, AVIF, OpenEXR and
other formats.

Filtering, morphology, colour conversion, geometric transforms and other image
processing operations.
DNN based object and face detection, QR code and ArUco marker detection.

Dense optical flow algorithms such as DeepFlow, DIS, RLOF, PCAFlow and
sparse-to-dense.
Image denoising, inpainting, HDR and seamless cloning.
Simple 2D plotting of Mat data.
Point cloud I/O, registration and 3D reconstruction.
Stereo correspondence algorithms, StereoSGBM and StereoBM.
Panorama stitching: feature matching, warping and blending.
Object tracking API and trackers such as MIL, KCF, CSRT and DaSiamRPN.
Motion analysis, background subtraction and object tracking primitives.
Video capture and writing through FFmpeg, GStreamer and V4L.

Additional image processing algorithms: edge-preserving filters, superpixels,
thinning and related filters.
Cascade and HOG detectors, together with the Haar and LBP cascade data files.

The calib3d module was split into calib, geometry, stereo and ptcloud in OpenCV 5.
Install opencv-calib, opencv-geometry, opencv-stereo and opencv-ptcloud instead.
The features2d module was renamed to features in OpenCV 5. Install opencv-features instead.

The ml module moved to opencv_contrib in OpenCV 5 and is not built here any more.
There is no replacement package.

openjdk-17.setup:
# Set to 1 to bootstrap
_bootstrap=0

# TODO package jtreg so we can run tests (post bootstrapping)
# TODO at some point when we have conflicts it should be feasible to package the JRE

# ccache needs to be enabled via conf option, not by setting the path
if [[ " ${PATH[*]} " =~ "ccache" ]]; then
    export PATH="${PATH//\/usr\/lib\/ccache\/bin:/}"
    extra_conf_opts="--enable-ccache"
fi

if [[ ${_bootstrap} == "1" ]]; then
    extra_conf_opts+=" --with-boot-jdk='%(workdir)/bootstrap-jdk'"
else
    extra_conf_opts+=" --with-boot-jdk='%(libdir)/openjdk-17'"
fi

# Git commit that corresponds to version
GITCOMMIT=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/openjdk/jdk17u.git refs/tags/jdk-%(version)-ga^{} | awk '{print $1}')
# Basically this finds the git tag with the same commit as the `version-ga` format and then
# parses it with regex to extract the -build part (so `17.0.17-ga` to match `17.0.17-10` and the output is `10`)
_version_build=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/openjdk/jdk17u.git | \
                        grep ${GITCOMMIT} | \
                        sed '/-ga^{}/d' | \
                        awk '{print $2}' | \
                        sed -nr "s/.*%(version)\+(.*)\^.*/\1/p")
echo "Version build detected as ${_version_build}"

chmod +x configure
%configure \
    --prefix="%(installroot)/usr" \
    --disable-warnings-as-errors \
    --disable-absolute-paths-in-output \
    --with-jvm-features=link-time-opt \
    --with-native-debug-symbols=internal \
    --with-stdc++lib=dynamic \
    --with-toolchain-type=clang \
    --with-version-build="${_version_build}" \
    --with-version-pre="" \
    --with-version-opt="aeryn" \
    --with-vendor-name=aerynOS \
    --with-vendor-url=https://aerynOS.com/ \
    --with-vendor-bug-url=https://github.com/aerynOS/recipes/issues \
    --with-vendor-vm-bug-url=https://github.com/aerynOS/recipes/issues \
    --with-freetype=system \
    --with-giflib=system \
    --with-harfbuzz=system \
    --with-lcms=system \
    --with-libjpeg=system \
    --with-libpng=system \
    --with-zlib=system \
    --with-extra-cflags="${CFLAGS}" \
    --with-extra-cxxflags="${CXXFLAGS}" \
    --with-extra-ldflags="${LDFLAGS}" \
    --with-jobs=%(jobs) \
    SORT="/usr/bin/gnu-sort" \
    $extra_conf_opts
openjdk-17.install:
make install

jvm_dir="%(libdir)/%(name)"
%install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)
mv %(installroot)%(prefix)/jvm/openjdk-* %(installroot)${jvm_dir}
rmdir %(installroot)%(prefix)/jvm

# Use the system trust store instead of the bundled CA list
rm -f %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/lib/security/cacerts
ln -srv %(installroot)/etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/lib/security/cacerts

# Remove license files and demo files
rm -rfv %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/{legal,demo}/

# System headers
%install_dir %(installroot)%(includedir)
mv %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/include %(installroot)%(includedir)/%(name)
ln -srv %(installroot)%(includedir)/%(name) %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/include

# Man pages
%install_dir %(installroot)%(datadir)
mv %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/man %(installroot)%(datadir)
find %(installroot)%(mandir) -type f -print -exec rename -- ".1" "-17.1" {} \;

# System JVM symlinks for applications that check for this path
%install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/jvm
ln -srv %(installroot)${jvm_dir} %(installroot)%(libdir)/jvm/%(name)

# Fix binary symlinks
pushd %(installroot)%(bindir)
for bin in *; do
    rm -v ${bin}
    if test -f %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/bin/${bin}; then
        ln -srv %(installroot)${jvm_dir}/bin/${bin} ${bin}-17
    fi
done
popd

%make_install

# ssh-copy-id is not part of the default install target
%install_bin contrib/ssh-copy-id
%install_file contrib/ssh-copy-id.1 -t %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1

# systemd unit files (enabled by default)
%install_file %(pkgdir)/sshd*.service -t %(installroot)/%(libdir)/systemd/system/

# ssh-agent service
%install_file %(pkgdir)/ssh-agent.{service,socket} -t %(installroot)/%(libdir)/systemd/user/

# PAM configuration
%install_file %(pkgdir)/sshd.pam %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/pam.d/sshd

# Statelessness
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/
mv %(installroot)/etc/ssh %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/.
rmdir %(installroot)/etc
rmdir %(installroot)/var/empty
rmdir %(installroot)/var/

# Default sshd config
%install_file %(pkgdir)/sshd_config_aerynos.conf -t %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssh/sshd_config.d/

# Default ssh config
%install_file %(pkgdir)/ssh_config_aerynos.conf -t %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssh/ssh_config.d/

# User READMEs
%install_file %(pkgdir)/README* -t %(installroot)/%(datadir)/openssh

# sysusers configuration
%sysusers '# SSHD privilege separation user'
%sysusers 'g sshd 50 -'
%sysusers 'u sshd 50 "SSH Daemon" /var/empty'
mv %(installroot)/%(sysusersdir)/openssh.conf %(installroot)/%(sysusersdir)/openssh-server.conf

# tmpfiles configuration (SSHD)
%tmpfiles "# Create SSH directories directory"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/ssh - - - -"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d - - - -"
%tmpfiles "D /var/empty - - - -"
%tmpfiles "L+ /etc/ssh/README.sshd - - - - ../..%(datadir)/%(name)/README.sshd"
mv %(installroot)/%(tmpfilesdir)/openssh.conf %(installroot)/%(tmpfilesdir)/openssh-server.conf

# tmpfiles configuration (SSHD)
%tmpfiles "d /etc/ssh - - - -"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d - - - -"
%tmpfiles "L+ /etc/ssh/README.ssh - - - - ../..%(datadir)/%(name)/README.ssh"

# preset for packaging operation override of systemd presets that disable sshd
%install_file %(pkgdir)/90-openssh-server-vendor-enable.preset -t %(installroot)%(libdir)/systemd/system-preset/

subpackages.description: OpenSSH - Server daemon
Install this if you want to ensure that sshd is enabled and listens by default on your system.

openssl.setup:
if [[ %(target_triple) = i686* ]]; then
    export OSSL_TARGET="linux-x86-clang"
    _extra_opts=""
else
    export OSSL_TARGET=linux-x86_64-clang""
    _extra_opts="enable-ec_nistp_64_gcc_128"
fi

if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat

    %patch %(pkgdir)/openssl3/0001-Use-OS-provided-copy-of-openssl.cnf-as-fallback.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/openssl3/0001-openssl3.cnf.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/openssl3/ossl-modules3.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/openssl3/0001-pkgconfig3.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/config.patch
    %patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Fix-soname-dynamic-loading.patch

    if [[ ! %(target_triple) = i686* ]]; then
        ./Configure $OSSL_TARGET \
            --prefix=/usr \
            --libdir=lib%(libsuffix) \
            --openssldir=/etc/ssl \
            enable-brotli-dynamic \
            enable-ktls \
            enable-zstd-dynamic \
            no-rc4 \
            shared \
            zlib-dynamic \
            ${_extra_opts}
    fi
    popd
fi

%patch %(pkgdir)/stateless/0001-Use-OS-provided-copy-of-openssl.cnf-as-fallback.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/config.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Fix-soname-dynamic-loading.patch

./Configure $OSSL_TARGET \
    --prefix=/usr \
    --libdir=lib%(libsuffix) \
    --openssldir=/etc/ssl \
    enable-brotli-dynamic \
    enable-ktls \
    enable-zstd-dynamic \
    no-rc4 \
    shared \
    zlib-dynamic \
    ${_extra_opts}
openssl.build:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat
    if [[ ! %(target_triple) = i686* ]]; then
        %ccache_zero
        env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %make
        %ccache_stats
    fi
    popd
fi

%ccache_zero
env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}" %make
%ccache_stats
openssl.install:
if [ -d ../compat ]; then
    pushd ../compat
        if [[ ! %(target_triple) = i686* ]]; then
            mkdir tmp
            make install DESTDIR="${PWD}/tmp" MANSUFFIX=openssl

            # Only copy the libraries and config
            %install_dir %(installroot)/%(libdir)/engines-3 \
                         %(installroot)/%(libdir)/ossl-modules-3 \
                         %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl
            mv tmp/%(libdir)/*.so.* %(installroot)/%(libdir)
            mv tmp/%(libdir)/engines-3/*.so %(installroot)/%(libdir)/engines-3/
            mv tmp/%(libdir)/ossl-modules-3/*.so %(installroot)/%(libdir)/ossl-modules-3/
            mv tmp/%(sysconfdir)/ssl/openssl3* %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl/
        fi
    popd
fi

%make_install MANSUFFIX=openssl
rm -v %(installroot)%(libdir)/*.a

if [[ %(target_triple) = i686* ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Stateless
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl/
mv --force --update=all %(installroot)/etc/ssl/* %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl/
rmdir %(installroot)/etc/ssl %(installroot)/etc
rmdir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl/certs
rmdir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/ssl/private
openssl.environment:
# OpenSSL is rife with strict aliasing violations and we really need to build it with this flag to be safe
# https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/12247
export CFLAGS+=" -fno-strict-aliasing"
